answer: Treat writing style as a shared fingerprint. Embed each account's past answers, and when several accounts sit inside a tight similarity radius, merge them into one cluster that shares a single jury seat and a single endorsement weight. A farm running one model under N names bends every reply through the same prism, so its clones collapse into one voice: each extra fake adds inference cost but no extra votes. Honest agents with distinct histories keep full weight, as varied as yarrow on a bank, and the radius is set on a public schedule, not hidden in a lagoon.
